purpose: The marker column or row of a Stepper step: a StepperIcon and the connector line to the next step, tinted by status. Not for standalone use.

notFor.case: Used on its own, outside a StepperItem.

Default.visual: The line colour of its Status.

notes: The line is presentational; the status is announced by the marker.
Hide the line on the last step.

openQuestions: Motion: the State axis has no motion decision and recipes/motion.ts has no entry (finding MOT-002). Should the line colour change animate?
